theme_set(theme_bw())

```{r  message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, results=FALSE}
genomeRepo <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace-contigs/genomes"
wd <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace-contigs"
path2mcscanx <- "~/miniforge3/bin"
asm2run <- list.dirs(genomeRepo, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)

parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = asm2run,
  genomeIDs = asm2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  gffIdColumn = "ID",
  genespaceWd = wd)

gpar <- init_genespace(
  wd = wd,
  nCores = 32,
  dotplots = 'never',
  path2mcscanx = path2mcscanx)

out <- run_genespace(gpar)
```


```{r orthogroup-summary, echo=FALSE}
orthofinder_dir <- tail(grep(
  "Results_",
  sort(list.dirs(file.path(wd, "orthofinder"), recursive = FALSE)),
  value = TRUE
), 1)
stats_dir <- file.path(orthofinder_dir, "Comparative_Genomics_Statistics")

overall_lines <- readLines(file.path(stats_dir, "Statistics_Overall.tsv"))
overall_lines <- overall_lines[seq_len(match("", overall_lines) - 1)]
overall_stats <- read.delim(
  text = paste(overall_lines, collapse = "\n"),
  header = FALSE,
  sep = "\t",
  col.names = c("Metric", "Value"),
  check.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  subset(overall_stats, Metric %in% c(
    "Number of species",
    "Number of genes",
    "Number of genes in orthogroups",
    "Percentage of genes in orthogroups",
    "Number of orthogroups",
    "Number of orthogroups with all species present",
    "Number of single-copy orthogroups"
  )),
  caption = "OrthoFinder orthogroup summary for the GENESPACE comparative genome set."
)
```

```{r orthogroups-by-species, echo=FALSE}
per_species_lines <- readLines(file.path(stats_dir, "Statistics_PerSpecies.tsv"))
per_species_lines <- per_species_lines[seq_len(match("", per_species_lines) - 1)]
per_species <- read.delim(
  text = paste(per_species_lines, collapse = "\n"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
rownames(per_species) <- per_species[[1]]
per_species <- per_species[-1]

species_summary <- data.frame(
  Genome = names(per_species),
  Genes = as.integer(per_species["Number of genes", ]),
  Genes_in_orthogroups = as.integer(per_species["Number of genes in orthogroups", ]),
  Percent_in_orthogroups = as.numeric(per_species["Percentage of genes in orthogroups", ]),
  Unassigned_genes = as.integer(per_species["Number of unassigned genes", ]),
  Species_specific_orthogroups = as.integer(per_species["Number of species-specific orthogroups", ]),
  check.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  species_summary,
  caption = "Per-genome orthogroup assignment statistics."
)
```


```{r synteny-contigs-tree-riparian, fig.width=7.2, fig.height=6.1}
tr <- read.tree(file.path(wd, "results", "SpeciesTree_rooted.txt"))
tree <- ggtree(tr)
peronospora_node <- getMRCA(
  tr,
  c("Peronospora_effusa_reassemble",
    "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013",
    "Peronospora_destructor_Pd_K2019")
)

tree <- ggtree::rotate(tree, peronospora_node)

tree_data <- tree$data
tip_data <- tree_data[tree_data$isTip, ]
tip_data <- tip_data[order(tip_data$y, decreasing = TRUE), ]
y_limits <- c(0.5, length(tip_data$label) + 0.5)

aligned_tree <- tree + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 10, l = 10))

full.plot <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = out,
  genomeIDs = rev(tip_data$label),
  refGenome = "Peronospora_effusa_UA202013",
  chrLabFun = function(x) "",
  useRegions = FALSE
)

aligned_synteny <- full.plot$plotData$ggplotObj +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = y_limits,
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = 1:length(tip_data$label),
    labels = rev(tip_data$label)
  ) +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black")
  )

synteny_contigs_plot <- aligned_tree + aligned_synteny + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 4))
save_pub_r(synteny_contigs_plot, "synteny-contigs-tree-riparian", width_mm = 180, height_mm = 170)
synteny_contigs_plot
```
